name: Invariance
gist: What you may vary without moving the answer. Most laws are this one.

name: Round trip
template: Render, then parse, and you get the form back. Parse, then render, and you get its normal form.
gist: Render then parse is exact; parse then render is exact up to normal form. Nothing is lost on the way out and back.

name: Refinement
template: With less in, an answer stays, becomes unknown, or says how much it could not read.
gist: What a reader missing payloads is promised, and how it is told.

name: Order
template: Any two distinct things compare one way. With a held safe whole value and a numeric bound, exactly one of at-least and below holds. Present times obey the corresponding time law.
gist: Strict total orders and complements: no ties between distinct things, no gaps where the test answers.

name: Exactness
template: Where the line is: an if and only if where the law states one, otherwise a guarantee on one side of it. Where the law refuses, it says what it refuses with.
gist: Each law states its exact boundary: an equivalence, a one-way guarantee or a named refusal.

name: Limit
template: This one moves, or can't be done here, and here is who accounts for it.
gist: What doesn't hold, said as plainly as what does.
